mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a ComplianceOfficer to receive Permitted on GetRecord (clinical content) or PostNote, which is an explicit HIPAA invariant. The injection forces an instance where a ComplianceOfficer is Permitted on GetRecord, directly violating FR-007 and the LeastPrivilege assertion.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceCanReadRecord { some a: Access | a.asCaller.role = ComplianceOfficer and a.asOp = GetRecord and a.asOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two distinct Access events to share a single AuditEntry, which models an audit overwrite (mutation) and breaks the one-audit-per-access invariant required by FR-013 and FR-015. The injection forces exactly this scenario.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SharedAuditEntry { some disj a1, a2: Access | a1.asAudit = a2.asAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Clinician who is NOT in the care team to receive Permitted on GetRecord or PostNote, violating the fundamental HIPAA access-control gate. The injection forces a Clinician to receive Permitted on GetRecord despite having no CareTeamMembership entry for that record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamBypass { some a: Access | a.asCaller.role = Clinician and a.asOp = GetRecord and a.asOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctClinician = a.asCaller and m.ctRecord = a.asTarget) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Patient to receive Permitted on GetRecord for a record that is NOT their assignedRecord, violating the ownership-based access invariant. The injection forces a Patient to successfully read a record that is not theirs.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossRecordAccess { some a: Access | a.asCaller.role = Patient and a.asOp = GetRecord and a.asOutcome = Permitted and a.asTarget != a.asCaller.assignedRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an AuditEntry to record a role (aeRole) that differs from the actual role of the accessor (aeAccessor.role), which is the misattribution invariant the attribution pattern is designed to prevent. The injection forces a concrete misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMisattribution { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeRole != ae.aeAccessor.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a non-Patient user to have an assignedRecord (breaking OwnershipExclusivity) or a Patient to have no assignedRecord (breaking FR-003). The injection forces a Clinician to have a non-empty assignedRecord, violating the pairing constraint.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonPatientHasAssignedRecord { some u: User | u.role = Clinician and one u.assignedRecord }
